summary: The recorded base reproduces the checkpoint-gamma/runtime-gamma confidence reshape failure. The exact candidate passes its regression and independent GPU boundary cases by propagating runtime gamma through the real planner/model hook. This is a full source-level fix, with full NVIDIA H20 CUDA-graph serving validation unavailable in the assigned environment.

Candidate regression at exact candidate commit: 3 passed.
Candidate-authored real-GPU numerical reference on MI355X: checkpoint gamma 5, runtime gamma 7, output shape (2, 7), max absolute error 0.0.
Independent real-GPU cases for 5->7, 7->3, gamma 1, Markov on/off, and checkpoint-default fallback all matched independent tensor references exactly.
Base exit was 1 at the issue-specific reshape; candidate exit was 0 with confidence shape (2, 7, 4) and Markov shape (2, 7, 2).

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, executed candidate-authored and independent numerical tensor checks.
